* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Catalina.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/First Date|First Date]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Bank.png]]Gasso gas station, Dillimore, Red County
|}

Drive into the red marker to trigger the cutscene. After the cutscene, you must get into the tanker cab, attach it to the trailer, and drive the tanker to RS Haul.

The gas station attendant will follow you in a car, shooting you and trying to disconnect the trailer from the cab. If the latter happens, try slowing down to minimize the chances of the trailer becoming disconnected.

Once you get to RS Haul, the mission is complete.

== Tips ==
* If you find the car chasing you is causing too many problems, you can destroy the car as soon as you have connected the cab and trailer. Just get out and shoot it (a heat-seeking RPG works quite nicely). Watch out for Catalina, because if she dies, you fail the mission.

== Rewards ==
* '''Cash''': $5,000
